title: Speaking — Making the most of a small space
description: Part 1 interview, a cue card and a Part 3 discussion on making the most of a small space.

questions: What do you enjoy doing when you have an hour to yourself?
Are your hobbies different from when you were younger?
Do your relatives share any of your interests?
Is there a hobby you would like to learn from someone?

part1.topic: Making the most of a small space
questions: Which part of your home do you find easiest to keep tidy?
What type of furniture is useful where you live?

part2.topic: Describe a small space that was cleverly arranged.
part2.closing: and explain what idea you would borrow for a space of your own.

part3.topic: Making the most of a small space
questions: How can housing designs respond to rising costs in large cities?
Are shared facilities a practical way to improve small apartments?
How has everyday life connected with making the most of a small space changed for people of different ages?
